name: AML Investigation Skill
description: Automated 6-step Anti-Money Laundering investigation pipeline. Traces stolen funds across EVM chains, discovers connected wallets, classifies entities via ML, and produces risk-scored reports.

max_depth.description: Maximum hop depth for fund tracing expansion

max_wallets.description: Maximum total wallets to include in investigation

steps.label: Import Case
steps.description: Create Investigation entity from case seed wallets. Maps CaseWallet → InvestigationWallet with role normalization and chain_id resolution.

steps.label: Trace Transfers
steps.description: Fetch ERC20 transfer history for all seed wallets via Etherscan v2 API. Stores transfers in chain-specific dynamic tables.

steps.label: Follow the Money
steps.description: Iteratively discover connected wallets by analyzing counterparties. Runs up to max_depth iterations. Each iteration: expand_investigation() → sync_investigation_transfers() for new wallets. Stops when 0 new wallets found or max_wallets reached.

steps.label: ML Classification
steps.description: Run production ML model + heuristic rules + known-entity matching on all wallets. Sources: ml_model (Random Forest), heuristic (rule-based), known (exchange/mixer/bridge databases).

steps.label: Risk Assessment
steps.description: Compute composite risk score (0-100). Factors: mixer interaction (+30), bridge crossing (+20), exchange endpoint (+10), anomaly detection (+15). Risk labels: CRITICAL ≥70, HIGH ≥50, MEDIUM ≥25, LOW <25.

steps.label: Generate Report
steps.description: Compile final investigation report via generate_investigation_report(). Aggregates all findings, classification results, risk assessment into structured report.

frontend.panel: Slide-out skill panel on Cases page
frontend.findings_display: Grid with risk meter and classification breakdown
